t: From Monolith to Modules: Building a Flexible Web App with FastHTML and HTMX
s: A local-first web app built with FastHTML and HTMX prioritizes radical simplicity, transparent server-side state management, and modular externalization, using an embedded LLM as a collaborative partner, to achieve future-proof resilience against enterprise complexity.
sub: Local-first, transparent, server-side state management with minimal core.
WET over DRY, linear pipeline workflows, and embedded LLM as collaborator.
HTMX for real-time interactivity, avoiding heavy JS frameworks.
Modularization via externalization of apps/workflows for plugin ecosystem.
Nix Flakes for reproducible environments, avoiding PyPI packaging complexity.
